name: Bounty Trail
storyline:
It is the fall of 1881 and your bounty hunting agency is in dire straits. Your no-good partner, Edward Thorne, took out a $10 000 loan and then took off. The debt must be paid by the end of the year so you’ve got no time to waste. Pick a target from the board, mount up, and set out on the Bounty Trail!
Once you reach the territory your bounty is hiding in, you’ll only have a few days to track him down. Explore the area, talk to farmers, look for supplies, and get the lay of the land. Once you track him down, you can try to bring him in alive if you think you’ve gathered enough information to safely do so, otherwise it’ll be a duel. Each one of these fellas is wanted dead or alive. Either way you get paid, but bringing your bounty in alive will earn you more experience, which will let you increase your skills. You’ll need those skills because the bounties will only get tougher and you only have 4 months to pay the debt. Get to it!
